name: agent-budget
description: Tracks each agent's context size and warns as it grows. Past the threshold main writes its handoff file and is compacted in place, then reads that file first; a subagent writes its handoff brief and stops.

warnTokens.title: Warn at (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Toast once when an agent's context first reaches this size. Capped at 60% of the point where the engine would auto-compact that agent.

rotateTokens.title: Hand off at (tokens)
rotateTokens.description: Past this size main refreshes its handoff file and is compacted in place when its turn ends; a subagent is told to write its handoff brief and stop. Capped at 75% of the point where the engine would auto-compact that agent, so the handoff always comes first.

repeatTokens.title: Repeat the handoff note every (tokens)
repeatTokens.description: After the first handoff note, repeat it once per this much further growth until a compaction resets the count.

includeMain.title: Track the main thread
includeMain.description: Track the main thread too: past the threshold it writes its handoff file and is compacted in place, as often as it fills up, never rotated to a new session.

handoffDir.title: Main's handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Absolute folder (or one under ~/) main's handoff goes under, as <handoffDir>/<sessionId>/main.md, overwritten each cycle. Empty means handoffs in Claude's config folder: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/handoffs, else ~/.claude/handoffs.

handoffMaxAgeDays.title: Remove main's handoffs older than (days)
handoffMaxAgeDays.description: Once per load, after a compaction of main, other sessions' <handoffDir>/<sessionId>/main.md files older than this are removed, and each folder left empty with them. 0 keeps every file.

showStatus.title: Show the status line entry
showStatus.description: Show the largest live subagent's size in the status line. Display only: tracking and notes run the same either way.

showToasts.title: Show toasts
showToasts.description: Toast at the warning, at the handoff threshold, and when main cannot be compacted. Display only: tracking and notes run the same either way.

addRuleToSpawns.title: Add the rotation rule to spawned agents
addRuleToSpawns.description: Append one standing sentence to every spawned agent's prompt telling it to follow an [agent-budget] note. Without it an agent may treat the note as untrusted and ignore it.
